description: This file defines structures, classes, and functions for handling keymaster messages and communication channels in a security context, specifically for Android's keymaster system. It includes message serialization, destruction, and communication interface definitions.

classes.name: KeymasterCommandDestroyer
classes.description: A functor class that destroys keymaster_message instances and wipes their memory.

classes.name: KeymasterChannel
classes.description: An interface class for synchronous communication channels that send and receive keymaster messages.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Function call operator that destroys a keymaster_message instance, wiping its memory.

methods.name: CreateKeymasterMessage
methods.description: Allocates and creates a new keymaster_message with specified command, response flag, and payload size.
